**STEP 7 - Energy:** Roasted potato with skin and a little oil is about 140 kcal/100 g, so 90 g ≈ 126 kcal. Carrot is about 35 kcal/100 g, so 3 g ≈ 1 kcal.

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** A partly covered side plate with one modest portion of roasted potatoes at about 90 g and about 127 kcal is plausible. Total: about 93 g and about 127 kcal.
